turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I have until 4:40, and I'd like the zero withdrawn before we do anything else.
An answer to what, Hale? I'm the one who's been waiting, since Owen found that zero on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided to enter it, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.
"Owen admits it in writing." Admits what, Hale, and on what basis? I'm writing down that you set a Friday 3 PM deadline for a seventeen-year-old before showing me a single document.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.

"Pick one." No. Your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish a concern, and it says nothing about a confession by Friday. Withdraw the zero, or I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done.
